description: Records a component's forced outage status directly rather than as a probability. outage_status is 1 when outaged, 0 when available; may be backed by a time series from simulation or historical records.
title: FixedForcedOutage

monitored_components.description: IDs of devices whose post-contingency state to model for this outage. Empty by default.

identifier.description: Optional user-supplied identifier for the outage, such as a name or a block id. Null when not set.
